# half-stache (Sam Hutcherson)

> Sam Hutcherson is a mechanical engineer and software developer. He builds iOS apps, websites for small businesses, and a hydrology model of the Little Red River in Arkansas, and he releases music under his own name. Client work runs through Hutchware LLC.

The site is one page at https://half-stache.github.io with a brand sheet at /brand/. The email address is halfstache@hotmail.com.

## Work

- [VectorShield](https://vectorshield.app): an iOS and Apple Watch app for people with alpha-gal syndrome. It scans products, checks medications against FDA data, and finds safe food, tuned to one of four sensitivity levels. A Chrome extension does the same on retail sites.
- [Riverstock](https://half-stache.github.io/#riverstock): a hydrology model of the Little Red River below Greers Ferry Dam that predicts river conditions at each access point. The model and data pipeline are built; the API and apps are in progress.
- [LavaRise](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/lavarise/id6759515609): a pixel-art climbing game for iPhone with 100 levels and 10 chapters.
- [Hutch's RV Park](https://hutchsrv.com): website, brand, and content system for the family RV park in Searcy, Arkansas.
- [Elrod Construction & Services](https://elrodconstructionservices.com): website, logo, and hero video for a home builder in Texarkana.

## Background

He has a mechanical engineering degree and finished as valedictorian and summa cum laude. He won a Startup Junkie healthcare boot camp. He was an account manager at his family's insurance agency, where he built document filing automation that saves each account manager thirty to sixty minutes a day.
